---
title: "compare-tpm-count-mitoscore"
author: "Dan Spakowicz"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
x <- read_csv("../data/tho_lung_cancer-mitoBuffa-TPM.csv")

head(x)
```

```{r}
x |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = MitoScore, y = MitoScore.TPM)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
lm0 <- lm(MitoScore ~ MitoScore.TPM,
          data = x)

summary(lm0)
```

```{r}
x |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = buffa.score, y = buffa.score.TPM)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
lm1 <- lm(buffa.score ~ buffa.score.TPM,
          data = x)

summary(lm1)
```

```{r}
lm2 <- lm(MitoScore ~ buffa.score, data = x)

summary(lm2)
```

```{r}
lm3 <- lm(MitoScore.TPM ~ buffa.score.TPM, data = x)

summary(lm3)
```

```{r}
BIC(lm2)
BIC(lm3)
```
